title: Alef WebGL Game
fullDescription: Alef WebGL Game is an engaging educational experience designed to teach children about climate change and empower them to take action. I initiated and created this project, and subsequently mentored and directed a team of developers to bring all the missions to completion. A core challenge was the game's open and interactive storytelling structure, where players not only collected items and played mini-games but also solved math problems, watched educational videos, answered quizzes, and engaged in building activities—all within a vast WebGL environment with numerous levels. Players begin by creating their own avatar, which then accompanies them throughout the missions. While the backend was developed by an in-house team, I focused on the frontend game logic and user experience. The game achieved significant traction with over 11,000 active users and an average playtime of 4 hours. To facilitate the creation of diverse missions, I utilized the Quest Machine asset, developing and providing numerous custom actions for other developers to use. The game features support for two languages, a simple inventory system, four distinct mini-games, and a user-friendly dialogue system, all built with Unity 3D and deployed for WebGL.
